name: GPU Face Extraction
definition: A GPU compute-based algorithm that extracts visible faces from a voxel subchunk (16x16x16) and outputs packed quads to a buffer, handling transparency and water occlusion rules.
summary: GPU Face Extraction is a compute-shader algorithm that extracts visible surface faces from voxel subchunks into packed quad descriptors, avoiding per-frame mesh generation by keeping descriptors resident until the subchunk becomes dirty.
